description: Create, update, or delete project/group labels. Actions: create (name + hex color required), update (modify properties), delete (remove permanently). Related: browse_labels for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete

color.description: The color of the label in 6-digit hex notation with leading '#' (e.g. #FFAABB) or CSS color name Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

description.description: The description of the label Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

label_id.description: The ID or title of the label Required for 'update', 'delete' action(s).

name.description: The name of the label Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

new_name.description: The new name of the label Required for 'update' action(s).

priority.description: The priority of the label. Must be greater or equal than zero or null to remove the priority. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

name: manage_label
